interact.bed.notYet: There's still something left to do today
interact.priceTag: Sneak a look at the price tag
interact.seat.head: Seat next to the boss
speech.meeting.intro: Weekly meeting. It's my turn. One phrase at a time with [Space], on the beat.
speech.toast.intro: Time for the toast. Everyone raises a glass and looks at me.
speech.pharmacy.intro: Pharmacy counter. Describe the symptoms, get the painkillers, get out.
speech.return.intro: Returns counter. I only have to get as far as "I'll come back another time."
speech.checkout.intro: The cashier is looking at me. Short. Keep it short.
day1.title: Monday, Weekly Meeting
day1.intro: Take the management office's call, go to work, say a few words at the meeting. Then home.
day2.title: Tuesday, Groceries After Work
day2.intro: The fridge is empty. Three ingredients from the supermarket on the way home. No avoiding the checkout.
dayWed.title: Wednesday, Half Day Off
dayWed.intro: Work the morning, then a half day off. Painkillers from the pharmacy, laundry at the laundromat. Clear the errands I've been putting off.
day3.title: Friday, Team Dinner
day3.intro: Team dinner tonight. Give a short toast, and get home before the second round.
day4.title: Saturday, Making a Return
day4.intro: Saturday. I have to return something to the clothing store. I heard there's a flea market in the park…
obj.meeting: Say a few words at the weekly meeting (required)
obj.work: Get work done at my desk
obj.home: Go home and lie down in bed
obj.dinner: Take a seat at the team dinner (BBQ)
obj.escape: Slip out before the second round (21:30)
obj.tryOn: Pick something and try it on in the fitting room
obj.return: Return the clothes: "I'll come back another time" (required)
obj.workHalf: Finish the morning's work (half day off)
obj.parcel: (Optional) Pick up a parcel at the management office
obj.market: (Optional) Look around the flea market in the park
phone.mgmt.inspection: Unit 302? We're calling about this week's fire inspection schedule.
phone.mgmt.fire: This is the management office. We wanted to check if today works for the fire inspection.
phone.boss.meeting: Please give us a quick progress update at the 10 o'clock weekly meeting.
phone.boss.friday: Team dinner tonight, 7 at the BBQ place. Don't be late!
phone.team.lunch: Anyone want to grab lunch together~? 🍜
phone.boss.halfday: Before your half day, please share the morning report.
phone.mgmt.parcel: A parcel for unit 302 is being held at the management office.
phone.mom.wed: Did you eat? Take your medicine after meals.
phone.friend.market: There's a flea market in the park on Saturday. Want to go? It's really fine if you don't.
phone.team.morning: Good morning, everyone~ Let's do our best today!
phone.team.dinner: Please react with an emoji if you're coming to tonight's dinner 🙏
phone.friend.park: Off work? I'm on a park bench. You don't have to talk, just come sit for a bit.
phone.friend.howsday: How was your day? No rush on replying.
phone.friend.sos: If the dinner gets to be too much, tell me. I'll pretend it's an urgent call. ([T] during a conversation)
phone.friend.cafe: I'll be at the café today. Stop by after your return.
phone.mom.dinner: Did you eat? Come by this weekend.
phone.mom.weekend: Not coming this weekend? I made side dishes for you.
phone.landlord.boiler: I'd like to schedule a visit from the boiler technician.
phone.landlord.again: You missed my call earlier, right? Calling again about the boiler.
phone.landlord.rent: Please confirm this month's rent payment.
phone.delivery.absent: Shall I leave your parcel at the door? Please reply by text.
phone.bank.card: Hello, we're calling to confirm your card issuance.
phone.title: Phone
dialogue.myLine.exit: Oh, I'm actually in a bit of a hurry…!
dialogue.waitBoss: There's no gap to cut in
work.title: Working
work.hint: Hold [Space]: focus  ·  When a message comes: [1] reply / ignore  ·  [Esc] short break
work.ping.boss: Team Lead: Can you check this?
work.ping.team: Group chat: lol look at this
work.ping.hr: HR: Please fill out the survey
work.done: Work's done. I look at the clock and it's already time to leave.
piano.title: Playing the Keyboard
piano.hint: Press the highlighted keys in order (A S D F G H J) · [Esc] stop
piano.done: The noise inside quieted down a little.
speech.hint: [Space] when the beat marker enters the green zone
umbrella.fromHome: It's raining. I grabbed an umbrella at the door.
dinner.grill.hint: [1][2][3] Flip the cooked meat · burn it and everyone looks
dinner.toastSoon: My turn for the toast is coming
dinner.secondRound: "Who's up for round two~?" Everyone's murmuring. I need to leave now.
priceTag.hint: Hold [Space] while the clerk isn't looking
clothesPick.done: Grabbed one of the last sizes left.
tryOn.done: Tried it on. Not really my style after all.
mirror.done: Practiced a few times in the mirror. Today's required interactions will be a little easier.
drip.done: Poured the pour-over into my tumbler. (+1 carry-along recovery)
sink.done: Dipped my face in cold water. My body calms down a little.
coldDrink.done: Something cold runs down my throat.
soloMeal.done: A solo seat. A meal where no one talks to me.
bench.done: Sat on the bench and listened to the wind.
doorLock.unlocked: Opened the door. Outside air comes in.
checkout.self.waiting: Waiting at self-checkout… beep, beep, beep.
safe.locked: Locked the stall. Nobody calls me in here.
escalation.bossVisit: The team lead came to my desk in person.
item.snack.desc: A little energy · slowly, when alone
item.coffee.desc: A little energy · eases tension · slowly, when alone
item.water.desc: Eases tension a little · eases flushing
item.herbalTea.desc: Eases tension a lot · slowly, when alone
item.coolPatch.desc: Eases flushing a lot · headaches a little
item.umbrella.desc: Stay dry outside on rainy days · reusable
use.snack: Finished the snack in a corner. I feel a little more alive.
use.coffee: Finished the coffee. It smells like home.
use.water: Drank the water slowly. My breathing evens out a little.
use.painkiller: Swallowed the pill. The throbbing in my temples fades.
use.herbalTea: Sipped the warm tea slowly. My shoulders drop.
use.coolPatch: Put a cool patch on my forehead. The heat drains away.
laundry.start: Started the laundry. Let's wait here until it's done. (Moving cancels)
laundry.cancel: Took the laundry out. I'll run it again another time.
chore.makeBed: Smoothed out the blanket. This bed will be waiting when I get back.
chore.feedCat: Bori buries her face in the bowl. Another day starts with this sound.
chore.waterPlants: The soil drinks up the water. The leaves lift a little.
chore.shower: Hot water. The words I heard today wash away with it.
chore.dishes: The dishes are done. With the sink empty, my mind feels a bit emptier too.
chore.recycle: Recycling sorted. The security guard gave me a nod.
browse.start: Between the shelves. The smell of paper and quiet music.
slip.phone: My hand slipped and I answered the call!
hud.controls: WASD Move · Shift Run · F Interact · E Earphones · Q Fake phone · C Cover cheeks · X Close eyes · V Mask · Tab Phone · M Map · 1–8 Items · O Settings · H Hide hints
screen.title: Do Not Disturb
screen.subtitle: The world is too loud, and my energy is limited.
screen.photosensitive: This game contains screen shake, flashing, and distortion effects. You can turn them off or reduce them in [O] Settings.
result.burnout.title: Melting down…
result.burnout.body: You ran out of energy. Not because you're weak, but because you tried that hard.
result.collapse.title: A Pause
result.collapse.income: Your work reputation hit bottom, and you got a warning about your job. But work can be found again. You are bigger than your job.
result.collapse.housing: The landlord sent an eviction warning. Wanting to avoid it is understandable. Tomorrow, try picking up just one call.
result.collapse.essentials: The fridge and the bank account are both empty. Today it's okay to ask someone for help instead of a delivery app.
result.collapse.bond: You've lost touch with your people. Even a single emoji can reconnect you.
night.title: {weekday} Night
night.body: I turned off the light and lay down. Let me sort through today.
night.rumination: Cringe moments I couldn't let go
night.hobby: A mind cleared by a hobby
report.comfort.0: Once again, you protected yourself amid the world's noise.
report.comfort.1: What you avoided and what you faced were both ways of getting through today.
report.comfort.2: A quiet person's day is far braver than it looks.
report.comfort.3: Recharging isn't running away. It's getting ready.
final.title: You Made It Through the Week
final.body: Monday's meeting, Tuesday's checkout, Thursday's presentation, Friday's dinner, Saturday's return. You did it your way.
settle.decay.bond: A day without keeping in touch
bag.full: My bag is full. I can't carry any more.
map.title: Map
map.hint: [M] Close · Yellow dot: me · Red dots: people I know
options.title: Settings · Accessibility
options.symptomGauge: Show symptom gauges (flushing, stutter, sweat, migraine, hurry)
hud.hintsHidden: Shortcut hints off ([H] to turn back on)
dinner.leave: Get up from the table (might get caught)
phone.friend.cancel: Sorry, something came up today… let's meet next time! 🙏
hap.elevatorCheck: Today is the elevator's routine inspection. I'll have to take the stairs.
hap.elevatorCheck.toast: "Under routine inspection. Please use the stairs."
hap.neighborMoving: The 3rd floor has been noisy since morning. Someone must be moving in.
hap.neighborAway: I hear the lady next door went on a trip. The hallway will be quiet.
hap.busker: There's supposed to be a busker on the boulevard this evening. It'll get crowded.
hap.quietStreet: For some reason, the streets are quiet today.
hap.roadwork: Roadwork started on the main road. The drilling is pretty loud.
hap.cafeQuiet: Café Calm is as calm as its name today.
hap.shower: Showers are forecast for the afternoon. Should I take an umbrella?
hap.phone.momSideDish: I sent you some side dishes. Put them in the fridge as soon as they arrive.
hap.phone.sideDishDelivery: [Delivery] Your package arrives today. If you're out, we'll leave it at the door.
hap.phone.storm1: Does anyone know where last week's meeting notes are~?
hap.phone.storm2: Aren't they in the shared folder?
hap.phone.storm3: Oh, found them! Thanks 🙏 (enjoy lunch, everyone)
hap.phone.friendCat: Send me a picture of Bori. Today was rough and I need a cat.
hap.phone.friendSong: Listen to this song. I thought you'd like it. No need to reply.
hap.phone.friendBread: I bought way too much bread. I'll hang some on your door. Won't ring the bell!
hap.phone.spam: Hello, we'd like to tell you about our low-interest loan…
phone.team.lunch.2: How about gukbap for lunch today? 🍲
phone.team.lunch.3: I posted a lunch menu poll~ 🗳️
phone.mom.dinner.2: They say it'll rain today. Don't catch a cold.
phone.mom.dinner.3: I made kimchi today. Take some next time.
coach.smile: Practice conversation. First, hold [Space] — keep smiling. Let go and their satisfaction drops
coach.question: A question → [3] short answer. Pressing right as they finish (yellow zone) is even better
coach.story: A story → [1] nod or [2] agree. When their satisfaction (face) fills up, the conversation ends
coach.remark: A remark → [3] short answer or [1] nod
coach.opening: A closing line. Press [4] leave in the green zone right as they finish to slip away immediately (an opening)
coach.wrong: That reaction was a bit awkward. It's practice, so it's fine — for real, the conversation drags on and your face turns red
coach.done: Practice over. From here on it's real. Every reaction costs energy.
energy.danger: Not much energy left. At 0 you'll slump down — rest somewhere quiet
energy.critical: Energy is at rock bottom. Rest now or you'll collapse
intro.gauges: When the energy at the top right hits 0, you slump down. The higher your tension, stress, panic, and meltdown, the faster energy drains (▼).
respawn.home: I come to and I'm home. A few hours have passed.
respawn.late: I come to and it's late at night. That's it for today.
use.sandwich: Finished the sandwich. I feel a little more alive.
item.bread.desc: A little energy · slowly, when alone
use.bread: Tore off the bread bite by bite and finished it.
item.banana.desc: A little energy · quick to eat
use.banana: One banana. Eaten in no time.
item.lunchbox.desc: Lots of energy · takes a while, somewhere quiet
use.lunchbox: Finished the lunchbox in a quiet corner. I can breathe again.
shop.homePantry: Home cupboard (uses a little of Daily Essentials)
shop.officePantry: Pantry snacks (free, one each per day)
item.book.desc: Calms the mind, a little energy · when alone · 2× a day
use.book: Read a few pages. Sentences that flow at my own pace.
item.fidget.desc: Eases tension · in my pocket, so anywhere · 4× a day
use.fidget: Squeezed the squishy in my pocket. My fingertips go quiet.
item.handCream.desc: Eases tension & flushing a little · anywhere · 3× a day
use.handCream: A scent I love. Slowly rubbed the backs of my hands.
shop.homeDrawer: Drawer — comfort items to take today
break.startFood: {item}. Let's stop for a moment and eat slowly.
break.startComfort: {item}. Just a moment, let me give myself some time.
break.watched: It feels like someone's watching, so my hands stopped. I'll finish when it's quiet.
break.stopped: Stopped what I was doing. Only got that far.
break.interrupted: Someone started talking to me, so I stopped.
use.enoughToday: That's enough of this for today.
obj.missed: '{obj}' — the time has passed. That's it for today. Again tomorrow.
dayThu.title: Thursday, the presentation
dayThu.intro: Today's the new project presentation. Check the slides, present in the meeting room, take the questions, and you're done. A quick rehearsal at the mirror at home might help.
note.thu.prepped: You sent a draft on Tuesday. Today is just a final check.
note.thu.notPrepped: You never sent the draft. The slides have to be done by 10:30.
note.thu.upstairs: The upstairs neighbor was thumping around again last night.
note.sat.tangerine: A bag of tangerines hangs on your doorknob with a note: "Sorry for all the noise. — 402"
note.sat.noise: Thump, thump, from upstairs again this morning. Better bring the earphones.
obj.workPitchCheck: Give the slides a final check
obj.pitch: Present the new project in the meeting room (required)
obj.upstairsNote: (Optional) Leave a note for upstairs with the memo pad by the door
obj.friendMoving: (Optional) Meet Jiu at the cafe — the last Saturday before the move
speech.pitch.intro: Front of the meeting room. Everyone's looking at you. [Space] on the beat, like turning slides.
speech.pitchQna.intro: "Any questions?" One hand goes up. Exit by the book.
phone.boss.pitchAssign: Oh, and would you take the new project presentation on Thursday? No pressure, ten minutes is enough.
phone.boss.pitchPrep: Could you share a draft of Thursday's slides sometime today? Rough is fine.
phone.boss.pitchDay: Good luck with the presentation today. Just walk through the slides, keep it easy.
phone.boss.pitchWhere: How far along are the slides? Just upload them by 10:30.
phone.boss.thanks: Thanks for the presentation this week. I won't message you over the weekend. Get some rest.
phone.team.pitch: Great job on the presentation 👏 the slides were clean
phone.team.pitch.2: Nice presentation! You were so calm during the questions
phone.friend.saturday: Off work? I'm on the park bench. Oh, and can we meet for a bit on Saturday? There's something I want to tell you. Nothing urgent.
phone.friend.nudge: Did you see my text yesterday? Take your time if you're busy.
phone.friend.moving: I'll just tell you now what I was going to say Saturday. I'm moving next month. Not far.
phone.friend.movingWorried: You didn't reply so I called. Everything okay? I'm moving next month.
phone.friend.thu: Saturday at 11, Cafe Janjan. I'll grab a spot where we don't have to talk.
phone.friend.nextTime: Looks like a busy week. That's okay, let's meet once before I move.
phone.mom.thu: How did the presentation go? I kept thinking about how nervous you must've been.
epi.pitch.ready: The draft sent on Tuesday, the rehearsal at the mirror on Thursday morning. The presentation was shorter than it felt.
epi.pitch.prepped: Sending the draft early on Tuesday saved Thursday's me.
epi.pitch.rehearsed: The slides were rushed, but the sentences practiced at the mirror came out first.
epi.pitch.rushed: Even the slides thrown together Thursday morning got through. The team lead said, "Good work. That's all."
epi.upstairs.talked: Said hello to 402 for the first time. They said elevators are awkward for them too. Now upstairs is 'the tangerine place'.
epi.upstairs.note: One note brought back a bag of tangerines. There was a way that didn't need words.
epi.upstairs.none: Upstairs is still thumping. That's okay. There are earphones, and there's next week.
epi.jiu.metCalled: Jiu said there's a quiet cafe in the new neighborhood too, and that we should meet there next time.
epi.jiu.met: Sat with Jiu at the cafe for an hour, barely talking. It was nice.
epi.jiu.answered: Jiu said, "Let's meet next time." It's good that there is a next time.
epi.jiu.none: Still haven't replied to Jiu. Sunday morning, you decide to write something short: "I'm doing okay. You?"
epi.closing: Sunday morning. Bori is dozing on the windowsill. Next week will be loud too. Still, there was at least one good moment.
gift.sidedish: Got braised beef from next door. (bag)
use.sidedish: Quietly ate the neighbor's side dish. Tastes like home.
note.sat.sidedish: The container came back to your door. Stir-fried anchovies this time. "Made it less salty~"
phone.seoyun.dinner: (Seoyun) I'm leaving after the toast too. Back door. You don't have to come with me.
epi.neighbor.thanked: Need to return the neighbor's container. A Sunday spent wondering what to put in it.
epi.neighbor.sidedish: The neighbor's container is still by the sink. Next week, return it with just one line: "It was delicious."
epi.cafe.regular: There's a 'the usual' at Cafe Janjan now. No names, but we know each other.
epi.seoyun.often: Not a single word exchanged, but the easiest person at work this week was Seoyun.
epi.seoyun.once: Someone nodded hello in the break room. That was enough.
